name: References Parameter
description: An ECS task definition revision names a Systems Manager Parameter Store parameter for one of its containers (revision -> parameter): containerDefinitions[].secrets[].valueFrom when it is a parameter ARN, or a parameter name, which ECS resolves in the task's own account and region. A name in a document, not a read: the ECS agent fetches the value under the execution role when a container starts, and that runtime flow is not this edge. One edge per revision and parameter.
